## 4. Critical supplier and code reconstruction

LAZY_LAW_AND_COST.md gives the independent whole reconstruction. Key hinges are:

* The conceptual empirical tables are independent of P data and all compiler/
  token uniforms. A fixed table defines ONE law, including unvisited nodes.
  Deferred decisions pay adaptive lazy visits without resampling a row.
* The first zero-count edge permanently switches that Qbar path to uniform.
  Every original-Q query is reached only through observed positive-count edges.
  The guarantee holds even outside the accuracy event and for infinite KL.
* Global R mixture probabilities are exact rational prefix combinations.
  Fine demanded digits concern the acquired law, not statistical recovery of
  unknown tiny Q probabilities. Uniform-component histories still obey the same
  root-path support check.
* Exponential conceptual-node count enters only a confidence logarithm.
  With B actual R queries, at most TB original-Q rows are exposed, giving at most
  mTB conditional FULL-FUTURE draws and mT^2B returned symbols. No descendant
  sample fragments are reused for free.
* Returning a finite model discards both sources and the empirical tree. All
  later token values, samples and selection comparisons use cached arrays only.

The literal adapter implements those rules with Fraction arithmetic. I checked
_row support certification, one-time cached counts, the absorbing _bar_prefix
path, exact global-mixture prefix/conditional ratios, latent-component posterior
sampling, common-denominator integer categorical tickets, public lock guard and
all source/counter conventions. Every API call exposes at most T new nodes;
shared-prefix evaluations do not multiply that bound. No original-Q value
evaluator is accepted by the class.

The adapter's conditional_draw and randbelow are supplied primitive contracts:
draws must be independent and randbelow freshly uniform, with randomness separate
from empirical batches. The code cannot validate those statistical premises.
Its source has only a stated AST/syntax check, not an end-to-end scientific or
finite-source execution. The review accepts its inspected mathematical logic at
that unexecuted-prototype scope, not runtime or numerical performance.

# Consistent empirical teacher with a support-safe escape

30 October 2026. Root's new construction, **PROPOSED pending whole challenge**.
This is the capital-first pair's next operation, building on the accepted
asymmetric compiler while challenging its central input suppliers. No new source,
model, solver or benchmark instance has been run. All frozen inputs stay intact.

## 1. Strong ordinary mechanism and the remaining interface

Liu--Moitra, arXiv:2411.07536v1, Section4.1, Claim4.1 and Lemma4.6, already
construct a consistent lazy empirical teacher supplying exact PDF/sample access
from conditional samples. I read that complete subsection from the cached primary
source. Its tree, empirical categorical rows and positivity mechanism are ordinary
prior machinery, not discoveries here. The substantive additional interface is
that our original Q can have zero-probability prefixes, and its conditional service
is permitted only at positive-Q prefixes. Simply adding local floors and querying
their new descendants would violate that contract.

The construction below repairs that interface. A small global uniform component
pays the remaining logarithmic cost. It removes the original VALUE supplier if
the full composition survives review. It does not make real resets or conditional
sampling physically free.

## 2. A conceptual tree, implemented only where needed

Fix rational 0<rho<=1/(10O), 0<alpha<=1/4 and failure probability beta. At every
positive-Q prefix h assign, conceptually and independently, m iid draws from the
next-token Q distribution. Let e_h(o) be the empirical fractions. Choose

    m >= [T log O + log(2T O/beta)]/(2 rho^2)

with a larger fixed constant if needed. A union bound over at most T O^T token
events makes ALL |e_h(o)-Q(o|h)|<=rho with probability>=1-beta. This conceptual
tree is never materialized; a visited active node draws its batch once and caches
the rational row. Conditional-on-past concentration, or equivalently independent
preassigned batches, justifies lazy adaptive visits.

Define a full-support distribution Qbar as follows. Initially its path is active.
At an active node h its token probabilities are

    qbar(o|h) = (e_h(o)+rho)/(1+O rho).
